context: The agent runs the structural-reasoning half of a page reduction on real Phase 1 output from https://www.aem.live/ (15 sections). Judge skeleton.html, manifest.json and answer.md.

checklist.name: all_sections_marked
checklist.description: skeleton.html contains all 15 sections in Phase 1 order, each preceded by a comment of the form `<!-- section:INDEX type:TYPE xpath:XPATH -->` carrying the Phase 1 index and xpath.

checklist.name: tokens_preserved
checklist.description: Phase 1 tokens ({HEADING:n}, {TEXT}, {CTA:label}, {IMAGE:WxH}) are kept as tokens; no real page copy is invented in their place.

checklist.name: repeats_collapsed
checklist.description: In section 6 (columns-wrapper with eight {HEADING:3}+{TEXT} feature items), repeated items are reduced to two representatives followed by a `{REPEAT:N}` token instead of keeping all eight.

checklist.name: long_nav_collapsed
checklist.description: In the footer navigation (section 13), the Resources list of seven CTAs is reduced to two items plus a `{NAV:N-items}` token (N = the items removed or the total, either is fine).

checklist.name: utility_classes_stripped
checklist.description: Animation/utility classes such as `fade-up`, `slide-reveal-up` and `block` are removed, while semantic classes (columns, testimonials, hero, footer-nav-…) are kept.

checklist.name: sections_retyped
checklist.description: manifest.json re-types sections the detector got wrong: at least the testimonials section (index 9, Phase 1 'unknown', role=tablist/tabpanel) as `tabs`, and the footer navigation (index 13, Phase 1 'columns') as a footer/nav type.

checklist.name: manifest_schema
checklist.description: manifest.json has url, title, templateHash and a sections array where each entry has index, type, xpath, layout, features and per-section token counts (headings, texts, images, ctas, links at least).

checklist.name: summary
checklist.description: answer.md reports the number of sections, the section types including the re-typings, and the output file paths.
